newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa-UAP says Banque Worms not long term.
newsitem.headline: Axa-UAP says Banque Worms not long term.

text.p: Axa-UAP chairman Claude Bebear said on Wednesday that Banque Worms was not a long term investment for the merged French insurance group.
Bebear said that the group intended to get Banque Worms in shape but "our vocation is not to keep Banque Worms long term."
He was speaking at a news conference at which the group's 1996 results were announced.

The bank, which was hard hit by exposure to France's real estate downturn, was part of the portfolio belonging to Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP). It made a negative contribution of 455 million francs to UAP's 1996 results against a negative contribution of 109 million in 1995.
Before exceptionals, its negative contribution in 1996 was 65 million francs.
